subject: Dedicated capacity follow-up: deployment mode decision + sizing clarifiers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@stratoretail.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@stratoretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity follow-up: deployment mode decision + sizing clarifiers

Hi Michael / Jill —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can size a dedicated pool and recommend the best deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) for StratoRetail.

Recap (what we heard):
- Goal: Production-grade inference for storefront personalization and post-purchase summaries.
- Timeline: POC in 3–4 weeks, production in Q3 if POC successful.
- Initial plan: Start with a POC (hosted or dedicated) and evaluate Private VPC for prod.

Sizing / deployment questions (please answer inline):
1) Target throughput: what is your expected sustained TPS and 95th/peak TPS during promotions?
2) Tokens per request: average input tokens and average output tokens (total tokens = input + output).
3) Concurrency: how many concurrent sessions do you expect (approx)?
4) Latency SLO: p50/p95 target in ms for the feature (for personalization we often see p95 <=300ms desired).
5) Preferred GPU families: do you have a cost vs latency preference (A100-80G, H100, L4)? If unsure, rank 1–3.
6) Traffic shape: steady or spiky (short bursts e.g., marketing emails / promo drops)? If spiky, how long are bursts and how big are they relative to baseline?
7) Data residency / network: will production require Private VPC / on-prem (security/compliance) or is hosted/dedicated acceptable?

Attachments: I attached a short capacity worksheet (capacity_worksheet_v1.xlsx) — fill the highlighted cells and we’ll run a quick mapping to pool sizes.

Next steps we propose:
- You fill the worksheet and reply with the numbers above.
- Ben will run an initial mapping and propose 1–2 pool options (GPU mix + node count).
- Book a 45-min sizing workshop next week to review benchmarks and procurement steps.

Thanks — appreciate the quick responses so we can get the POC scoped.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: capacity_worksheet_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@stratoretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@stratoretail.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: deployment mode decision + sizing clarifiers

Thanks Karthik — answered inline below. I've pasted short answers to each question to keep things simple.

1) Target throughput: sustained ~20 TPS; typical peak ~120 TPS during flash promotions (peaks last ~10–20 minutes).
2) Tokens per request: input ~60 tokens, output ~140 tokens (we estimate ~200 total tokens on average).
3) Concurrency: we expect 80–130 concurrent requests at peak; baseline concurrency ~25.
4) Latency SLO: p95 target is 500ms for now (we can tighten later).
5) Preferred GPU families: cost-conscious team prefers A100-80GB (rank 1), but we are open to H100 (rank 2) if it materially reduces latency for the personalization model. L4 is lower cost but unproven for our model size.
6) Traffic shape: spiky — daily peaks around promotional emails and weekend traffic surges. Bursts can be 5–6x baseline for 10–30 minutes.
7) Data residency / network: production requires VPC peering with our cloud account (for audit and data controls). For the POC we can use Dedicated in Redwood's hosted environment with IP allowlisting; production should be Private VPC.

I've attached our internal procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf) showing a Q3 procurement decision gate.

Let us know if you need more granularity on model size — we will share the model artifact if needed for benchmarking.

—
Michael Torres
Head of ML Engineering, StratoRetail Inc.
michael.torres@stratoretail.com

Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@stratoretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: deployment mode decision + sizing clarifiers

Appreciate the clear answers, Michael — this is helpful. Quick mapping from our side based on ~200 tokens/request and the throughput you gave:

- For sustained ~20 TPS and peaks ~120 TPS (bursty): a Dedicated reserved pool sized to handle baseline with burst headroom is a good fit.
- Rough starting recommendation: 4 x A100-80GB nodes (in a single pool) with autoscale burst to an additional 2 nodes for promos.
  - If you want to prioritize latency and reduce p95 below 300ms, consider 3 x H100 nodes instead (higher cost but better p95).
- We can use continuous batching + prefix/KV caching to lower effective GPU work during bursts — this often reduces token cost by ~15–35% depending on prompt reuse.

Questions for you: is the model you plan to serve a 70B-ish dense model or a quantized 30–40B variant? That affects memory and GPU choice. Also, do you have a target monthly token volume (approx)?

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik and I will run a quick micro-benchmark (we can do a 6–8 hour run) on your model or a close proxy to validate p95 and effective throughput per node.
2) Book a 45-min sizing workshop (I dropped a proposed slot in the shared Drive link).
3) We’ll provide a cost comparison (A100 vs H100) and an ops checklist for moving from Dedicated -> Private VPC for production.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-stratoretail-sizing (benchmarks + worksheet)

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

P.S. I added a few notes in the capacity_worksheet_v1.xlsx — ask if you want me to prefill with our initial mapping.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@stratoretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: deployment mode decision + sizing clarifiers

Thanks Michael — that gives us what we need to start. Proposed next steps:

1) Sizing workshop: Please pick one of these slots and confirm:
   - Tue 11 May, 10:00–10:45 PT
   - Wed 12 May, 14:00–14:45 PT
2) Benchmarks: Ben will run a 6-hour micro-benchmark on your model proxy once you share the artifact or allow a test model. We’ll post results to the Drive folder.
3) Procurement: we’ll prepare a Dedicated -> Private VPC uplift plan and cost delta for procurement.

I’ve attached the StratoRetail capacity worksheet with our initial notes (stratoretail_capacity_worksheet.xlsx). Please fill the highlighted cells for token volume and confirm the preferred GPU ranking so Ben can finalize the estimate.

We’ll also prepare a short one-pager on tradeoffs (A100 vs H100 vs L4) tailored to your token profile.

If that all looks good I’ll have Ben and Laura draft the workshop invite and pre-read.

Best —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
